sources.title: Shantou Undersea Data Center Phase 1 project: sea-area use demonstration report (public version), attachment to the October 16, 2026 Shantou NRB notice
sources.publisher: Shantou Natural Resources Bureau (attachment; report prepared for HiCloud (Guangdong) Technology Co., Ltd.)
sources.attribution: Shantou Natural Resources Bureau; HiCloud (Guangdong) Technology Co., Ltd.
sources.summary: 197-page public version of the applicant's sea-use demonstration report. New commercial (经营性) project; investor and construction unit HiCloud (Guangdong) Technology Co., Ltd.; investment CNY 216.12 million; one offshore data-capsule platform of 7 MW installed capacity (topside with a computing deck of 16 compute modules, an underwater heat-exchange capsule, four-pile jacket, outer size 39 m x 45.3 m), seawater-cooled (about 720 m3/h, temperature rise at most 5 C), 4.8658 ha of sea area for 16 years, about 17.8 km from the Dahao Island shore and 17.4 km from Nan'ao. The platform will take the 66 kV array cables of turbines #45F/#46F/#61F/#62F and #57F-#60F of the Datang Nan'ao Lemen I offshore wind expansion (354 MW, fully grid-connected August 12, 2025) and connect by two new 66 kV cables (1.72 km) to that farm's offshore substation, using the farm's export cable for data. The feasibility study cited is the 'Shantou 7 MW domestic ten-thousand-card data capsule project'. Planned total construction period 318 days. Figure 7.5.3-1 (printed p. 168) plots the sea-use area on China MSA chart No. 81001 (CGCS2000, 1:150,000); boundary-point coordinates are withheld as not public.
sources.date_semantics: Report attached to the October 16, 2026 notice; PDF internal creation date October 16, 2026. Describes a proposed project; its construction schedule is a plan, not an observation.
sources.coordinate_crs: Location map drawn on chart No. 81001 (CGCS2000, Mercator). Registered to EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless 2025 using two offshore-substation platforms and six wind-turbine rows; printed meridians 117°00'/117°05' E and parallel 23°15' N fall within about 25-125 m of their registered values.
